stem: A bank wants automatic high availability and separate read scaling for an RDS workload, and needs distinct mechanisms for each goal. (Select TWO.)

choices.text: Use read replicas to provide synchronous standby failover.
Use Multi-AZ standby topology as the dedicated read-scaling endpoint.
Use Multi-AZ DB instance deployment for synchronous standby failover.
Use a larger writer instance class as the read-scaling mechanism.
Use read replicas for asynchronous read traffic offload.

rationale: A Multi-AZ DB instance deployment provides synchronous standby failover for availability, and read replicas provide asynchronous read offload for scaling, which gives each goal its own mechanism. Read replicas are asynchronous and are not a synchronous failover target. A Multi-AZ standby does not serve reads, so it cannot be the read-scaling endpoint. Scaling the writer up adds capacity to the single endpoint rather than giving read scaling a mechanism distinct from the availability design.
